acceptanceCriteria: Measured before/after git status latency under comparable load, with a decision to adopt or reject recorded.
body: Isolated git status in the hook adapter costs 200-370 ms at load 40-80 with about 1,467 dirty paths. Hypothesis: core.untrackedCache and/or fsmonitor lowers it. Must not mutate user config permanently or break read-only invariants.
title: Try git untrackedCache/fsmonitor for the isolated git status read in the hook adapter
